# Platform

## Mission

The platform team runs the shared services, owns the on-call rota and the deployment tooling, and supports every product team that needs infrastructure advice or a review of a design. The follow-up items are tracked in the shared log, reviewed every week, and closed only when the owner confirms the result in writing.
